name: com.sap.ec.unity
description: Unity plugin for the SAP Engagement Cloud SDK on macOS. Setup, contact, event, in-app messaging, config, and deep-link APIs. In-app messages composite into Unity's rendering as Texture2D.

samples.description: Track custom events with string attributes.
Display an in-app message as a Unity Texture2D.
Read/write config values (application code, language, SDK version).
Forward a URL to the SDK's deep-link handler.
